plasencia--alma-fuerte-natural.description: A Nicaraguan puro from Estelí, made with aged tobacco from the Plasencia family's reserves under a Colorado Claro wrapper, with some sizes pressed into a hexagon. Medium to full, it unfolds almond, cedar and cocoa with a light touch of nutmeg; a cigar for a slow glass of bourbon.

plasencia--alma-fuerte-oscuro.description: The oscuro edition of Alma Fuerte, a Nicaraguan puro from Estelí rolled with aged tobacco from the family vault, its vitolas named after generations of Plasencia growers. Bold and intense, it brings dark chocolate, ripe plum and cinnamon, finishing long on oak and molasses; well matched with a sweet Speyside malt.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Plasencia Alma Fuerte Generación V review

thirds.notes: In the Generación V, a strong start of pepper quickly gives way to sweet chocolate, toast and earth, with a floral retrohale.
Chocolate stays in charge with earth and toast, a quiet citrus note and pepper back on the retrohale; smooth and balanced.
Earthier, with chocolate in the background, a lightly floral finish and a sweeter retrohale with almost no pepper.

plasencia--alma-del-campo.description: A Nicaraguan puro honouring Finca La Limonera in Jalapa, where the family first planted Cuban Habano seed after leaving Cuba. Smooth and refined, it offers coffee, chocolate, toasted nuts and sweet wood over creamy undertones, with a floral lift from the Jalapa leaf; a balanced morning cigar, good with a mocha.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Plasencia Alma del Campo Tribu review
Blind Man's Puff – Plasencia Alma del Campo Tribu blind review
Cigar Dojo – Plasencia Alma del Campo Tribu review

thirds.notes: Creamy espresso with fresh bread and cedar, bright pepper and exotic spice, touched by oak, cocoa and a citrus lift.
Espresso and cedar continue with a buttery note, stronger pepper, dried-fruit sweetness and a hint of tangerine on the finish.
Simpler and roastier, with cedar, coffee, wood and nuts, and a turn to bitterness if smoked hot.

plasencia--alma-del-cielo.description: Grown above 3,500 feet at Hacienda San Julián in Condega, the estate Néstor Plasencia bought back for his wife, Alma del Cielo is a Nicaraguan puro of sweet, delicate character. Marzipan and honey open, earth, orange zest and cedar follow, and ginger spice lingers on the finish.

plasencia--alma-del-fuego.description: Grown in the volcanic soil of Ometepe, an island in Lake Nicaragua where Néstor Plasencia began growing cigar tobacco in 1996, Alma del Fuego is a Nicaraguan puro with a peaty, spicy character. Full in strength yet balanced, it shows spice with tangerine, roasted cashew and a light smoky wood.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Plasencia Alma del Fuego Candente blind review
Cigar Dojo – Plasencia Alma del Fuego Candente review

thirds.notes: Cedar, espresso and a hidden black pepper, or cinnamon and pine over damp, clay-like earth and charred oak.
Chocolate and espresso with flashes of cream, and roasted almond or cashew as the spice softens.
Pepper and earth come forward while the cedar dries into oak, with a hint of leather and a more muted aroma.

plasencia--reserva-original.description: Made entirely from certified organic tobacco grown in Estelí, Condega and Jalapa, Reserva Original is the result of nearly a decade of work by fifth-generation grower Néstor Andrés Plasencia. Medium-bodied and harmonious, it brings nuts and earth with cocoa, caramel and fresh bread, then marzipan and a smooth cedar finish.

sources.title: Bespoke Unit – Plasencia Reserva Original review

thirds.notes: A gentle start of resinous, floral notes, rosewood and malt, sitting mostly at the front of the palate.
Darker and more aromatic, with a charred, earthy note, a hint of grape and nutmeg.
Mineral earth, pepper and sandalwood, as the flavour finally reaches the back of the tongue.

plasencia--cosecha-149.description: Named for the Plasencia family's 149th harvest since 1865, Cosecha 149 is a Honduran puro made from 2014-2015 tobacco grown in the Jamastrán, Talanga and Azacualpa valleys. Full-bodied, it combines toasty spice with walnut, cream, dark chocolate, raisin and an earthy oak note; a cigar for aged Caribbean rum.

sources.title: Famous Smoke Cigar Advisor – #NowSmoking Plasencia Cosecha 149
Blind Man's Puff – Plasencia Cosecha 149 Azacualpa blind review

thirds.notes: Light pepper and espresso give way to cream, earth and slight sweetness, with leather, cedar and baking spice.
Leather and cedar or oak take the lead, with mild spice, cream, light coffee and a faint floral touch.
Dark chocolate joins leather, cedar and baking spice, pepper rises and a sweet grassy note closes it.

plasencia--cosecha-151.description: Marking the family's 151st harvest, Cosecha 151 is a Honduran puro of Jamastrán tobacco from the 2016-2017 crops. Full-bodied with a generous, creamy smoke, it layers roasted coffee, pecan, dark chocolate and prune, finishing with cinnamon and oak; a cigar for Cognac or Armagnac.

thirds.notes: Cacao nib and bitter chocolate with dark berries, then soil, sweet cedar, coffee, raw pecan and old leather.
The roasted pecan grows, peppercorn moves onto the tongue and the smoke gains oil and strength without new turns.
Espresso and steamed milk take over, with chocolate, resinous cedar, minerals and a salty, charred-wood finish.

plasencia--el-ano-de-la-cabra-year-of-th.description: The seventh release in Plasencia's Chinese Zodiac series, a perfecto rolled in Honduras with an Azacualpa wrapper, a Jamastrán binder and mostly Jamastrán filler, plus a little organic Estelí tobacco. Toasted oak and espresso open, dark chocolate, dried fruit and damp earth follow, and walnut, cinnamon and clove close it out.

sources.title: Plasencia Cigars – Year of the Goat 2027

plasencia--triunfal-2026.description: The second release in Plasencia's Mundial limited series, Triunfal combines organic tobacco from Honduras and Nicaragua: a Jamastrán wrapper, an Olancho binder and Jalapa and Jamastrán filler, in 5,000 numbered boxes. Medium in strength and body, it moves from toffee and cedar to cream, almond and rain-soaked earth, ending on molasses.
